sn13.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn13.1:1.3: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn13.1:1.5: katamannu kho bahutaraṃ yo vāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavīti?
sn13.1:2.2: appamattako nakhasikhāyaṃ bhagavatā paritto paṃsu āropito.
sn13.1:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
sn13.1:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etadeva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ,
sn13.1:2.6: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti, purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃ paramatā.
